remarks: Sky-High Living with Unmatched Views - 1 Bedroom/1 Bath Penthouse at Strawberry Hill Court.  Welcome to your private retreat in the sky! Perched atop the coveted Strawberry Hill address, this one-of-a-kind rooftop penthouse offers breathtaking 360 panoramic views-from the glittering skyline of Manhattan to sweeping vistas of Long Island Sound and the vibrant cityscape of Stamford below.  This beautifully designed 1-bedroom, 1-bath penthouse spans 640 square feet of refined living space. The sun-drenched living room frames stunning urban views, creating the perfect backdrop for relaxing or entertaining. A chef's kitchen is outfitted with cherry cabinetry, granite countertops, and high-end appliances including a cooktop, wall oven, Sub-Zero refrigerator, microwave and dishwasher.  The elegant bathroom, wrapped in warm limestone, offers a serene escape, while the generously sized walk-in closet adds practical luxury. Additional features include garage parking plus a outdoor parking space, doorman service, and secure building access. Please note: the penthouse is accessible via elevator to the top floor, followed by one flight of stairs. There is no roof access from within the unit.  Located across from the Tully Center and minutes from Stamford's shops, dining, train station, and beaches-this rare penthouse offers an extraordinary lifestyle at the top of the city. Please schedule your private viewing before it's gone!
